name: Kokonoe Akane
source:
The leader of the "Crimson Wings," a budding organization with only two members. Preferring to dress in red, she wields a large spear. She encounters Kusuhara and the others while on her way to destroy the Connect Center. She claims to be a "victim" of the Connect Center's "wrongdoings," saying that her precious family was sacrificed.

Is what she says really true? What does she mean by "wrongdoings"?
